mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, it is 53 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, under a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has updated its list of polling locations with two additional spots added last September. Residents are encouraged to visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their specific ward's polling place, or contact the City Clerk at 608-845-6495 for assistance.
Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy the Thursday night atmosphere at ART House 360, or join the free trivia session at Hop Haus Brewing Co. starting at 6:30 PM.
On October 7, police investigated a vehicle collision on Basswood Avenue at Hemlock Drive, where a minor operating an electric motorcycle collided with a vehicle while attempting to pass.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently closed but will open its doors today at 10:00 AM for your enjoyment.
